Virat Kohli.weakness: Vulnerable to the 5th stump line on a good length early in the innings. Can be drawn into a false drive.

Ajitesh Guruswamy.weakness: Struggles to rotate strike against hard lengths into the ribcage. Often mistimes the pull shot when rushed.

Andre Russell.weakness: Struggles to get under the wide yorker outside off, especially if it is bowled at express pace.

Rohit Sharma.weakness: Historically struggles against left-arm inswing hitting the front pad early on.

Glenn Maxwell.weakness: High risk of attempting the reverse sweep. Fire it flat and wide outside off stump to force a mistake.

AB de Villiers.weakness: Very few weaknesses, but can occasionally be cramped for room by a searing bouncer targeting the left shoulder.
